# building-an-exo (third-party Claude skill)

> **Not lab work.** This is someone else's work, stored unmodified for reference. The lab
> makes no claim about it. Nothing here is a `verified` row in [CLAIMS.md](../../CLAIMS.md).

## What it is

A Claude Skill package, `building-an-exo` version 1.5.0 (created 2026-05-01, updated
2026-06-22 per its `config.toml`). It encodes the operating model published as *The
Organizational Singularity* (OS Outline v25, June 2026): ExO 3.0, the Intelligence Stack,
the REWRITE Playbook, DRIVE and SHAPE, Edge Twin and Edge Deployment, and related
diagnostics and governance frameworks. It contains instructions, reference documents,
templates, a schema and config. It contains no executable scripts.
